subject: Arbiter pilot kickoff & handoff: ramp owners and POC readiness
messages:
From: Olivia Chen <olivia@arbiter.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>; Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Li <marcus@arbiter.ai>
Date: 2026-08-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Arbiter pilot scope / kickoff and next steps

Hi Rishi / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — we left excited to move to a short pilot. Quick summary from our side and a few asks so we can hit the target start dates: 

Pilot objective:
- Validate inference latency at scale for our contextual search product (90th pct < 200ms on 6k qps simulated burst)
- Verify end-to-end integration with our API (model outputs -> rerank -> client UI)

Key constraints / asks:
- We prefer Redwood Dedicated (reserved pool) for the pilot; we will request a VPC peering for data egress control.
- We can provide a 2-week anonymized sample corpus today (see attached Arbiter_Pilot_Data_Specs.csv).
- Need sandbox API keys and example Python SDK snippets for streaming + function call tests.
- Legal: we attached our standard SOW draft and would like the MSA countersigned before production. DocuSign link in-line if helpful.

Target dates:
- Sandbox creds + sample dataset: by Sep 3
- Pilot start (internal testing): Sep 13
- Pilot review with metrics: Sep 27

Attached: Arbiter_SOW_draft.docx, Arbiter_Pilot_Data_Specs.csv

If there’s anything else you need from procurement/legal here, flag it and we’ll loop them in.

Thanks,
Olivia Chen
Head of Product
Arbiter.ai

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>; Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>; Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Olivia Chen <olivia@arbiter.ai>; Marcus Li <marcus@arbiter.ai>
Date: 2026-08-30T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Arbiter pilot scope / kickoff and next steps (sales -> CS handoff)

Team — forwarding Arbiter’s kickoff note. Short internal summary and asks for CS/implementation: 

Deal highlights:
- ARR (first year run): ~ $120k; expected expansion if latency and inference cost meet their targets.
- Pilot is Dedicated/GPU-backed; they want VPC peering and SSO for their engineering team.
- Signed LOI is attached; MSA is in DocuSign (they asked us to countersign).

Open items (sales notes):
1) Sandbox keys + sample dataset due Sep 3 — we should be ready to supply a dedicated sandbox in a US region (we quoted us-west-2).
2) Tech metric: 90th pct latency < 200ms under a 6k qps simulated burst — this is aggressive, may need kernel-level optimizations + pre-warmed KV cache.
3) Billing: monthly invoicing, net-30; procurement may want a PO.
4) Legal redlines: they’ve attached an SOW; their legal also CC’d.

Requesting action:
- Marissa: can you own the customer relationship and run the mutual action plan?
- Karthik: please scope the implementation runbook (network, peering, sandbox onboarding, SSO) and confirm feasibility of the latency target with inference team.
- Priyom: can you prepare a short pre-warm / load test checklist and estimate the Dedicated pool sizing for the pilot?

Attachments: Signed_LOI_arbiter.pdf (attached in HubSpot), Arbiter_SOW_draft.docx, mutual_action_plan.xlsx

Thanks — I’ll be available if you need context on the negotiation.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Cc: Olivia Chen <olivia@arbiter.ai>; Marcus Li <marcus@arbiter.ai>
Date: 2026-08-30T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Arbiter pilot scope / kickoff and next steps (CS owners + timeline)

Thanks Rishi — I’ll take lead on the customer side. Quick plan and owner assignments below. I’ve added tentative dates based on their asks.

Owner assignments:
- Customer success lead (primary): Marissa Cole — main point of contact for status, success criteria, and rollout decisions.
- Implementation (tech lead): Karthik Iyer — responsible for sandbox provisioning, VPC peering coordination, and SSO configuration.
- Solutions engineering: Priyom Das — load testing, pre-warm checklist, and help with kernel/quantization tuning recommendations.

Immediate next steps (action items):
1) Karthik: confirm sandbox build spec + provide ETA for sandbox API keys (target Sep 2 EOD).
2) Priyom: draft a Dedicated pool sizing recommendation and pre-warm test plan (includes KV cache warm-up sequence, batch sizing suggestions).
3) Marissa/Rishi: coordinate DocuSign countersignature and confirm PO process with Arbiter procurement.
4) Marissa: schedule an internal 30-min sync with Arbiter on Sep 6 to review onboarding checklist and security questions (SOC 2 / data residency).

Risk notes for the runbook:
- Their 6k qps burst target will likely require temporary burst capacity and careful batching; we should line up a follow-up with the runtime team if Karthik needs kernel-level changes.
- Data residency: they’ve expressed concern but their initial data sample is anonymized; legal will confirm MSA clauses.

I’ll create a shared Pilot Runbook in the Arbiter Drive folder (link below) and update the mutual_action_plan.xlsx with owners and deadlines today.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: pilot_runbook.md (placeholder — will populate after Sep 2 sandbox confirmation)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>

Cc: Olivia Chen <olivia@arbiter.ai>; Marcus Li <marcus@arbiter.ai>; Legal Team <legal@arbiter.ai>
Date: 2026-08-31T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Arbiter pilot scope / kickoff and next steps — implementation plan draft

Thanks — I’ll take the implementation workstream. Preliminary plan below (will publish a one-page runbook by EOD Sep 2):

Phase 0 (by Sep 2)
- Sandbox spec: minimal Dedicated pool (2x A100-equivalent) in us-west-2 for initial integration and streaming tests.
- Deliverable: sandbox API keys + example SDK snippet for streaming and function calling.
- Network: request VPC peering details from Arbiter (CIDR, contact) — Marissa, can you set up the Sep 6 sync to capture this?

Phase 1 (Sep 13 start)
- Integration: deploy model variant pinned to the performance profile we discussed (redwood/gpt-large-v1-optimized).
- Load test: run burst simulation (6k qps) in a staged environment with Priyom running the pre-warm sequence.
- Metrics: capture 50/90/99 latency, token throughput, and per-token cost estimate for the pilot.

Phase 2 (Sep 27 review)
- Joint readout with Arbiter product and infra teams; decisions on production sizing and billing model.

Open asks / blockers:
- DocuSign MSA: Legal needs final countersignature before we flip production capacity. Rishi / Marissa — can you confirm when DocuSign will be completed?
- Data sample: need the anonymized CSV (they mentioned sending today) mounted or uploaded to our sandbox dataset bucket. Marcus / Olivia — can you confirm upload path or share a Drive link?

I’ll attach the initial runbook and pre-warm checklist to the Drive folder and link it in the HubSpot deal. Priyom — I’ll ping you offline to align on batch sizes and kv-cache strategy.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Implementation Lead
Redwood Inference
